title.narrative: Capacity-Building on Preventing Illicit Trafficking of Cultural Property in Tanzania.

description.narrative: “Capacity-Building on Preventing Illicit Trafficking of Cultural Property in Tanzania” aims at strengthening awareness, knowledge, and capacities related to the protection of cultural property and the prevention of illicit trafficking in Tanzania. The engagement responds to the growing need to strengthen preventive measures, awareness, and stakeholder capacities to safeguard cultural property and promote the protection of Tanzania’s cultural heritage.
